chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
To miss what one needs is easier than to beg from an inappropriate person.

key_terms.أَهْلِهَا: its people / those suitable for it

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of missing out on a need rather than begging from the wrong people?
ai.summary: In Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) contrasts the temporary hardship of unfulfilled need with the spiritual degradation of seeking from the unworthy, a concept deeply rooted in the Shia emphasis on *‘iffah* (chastity of spirit) and social dignity. This teaching serves as a practical guide for maintaining self-respect and avoiding the psychological burden of dependency on those who may not give sincerely or who might exploit the supplicant's vulnerability.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 66. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
To miss what one needs is easier than to beg from an inappropriate person. [1]
